row: South West Florida Horse Rescue, Inc.

We are a Southwest Florida based Equine Rescue located in Charlotte county Florida.  We strive to be the VOICE for equines that have been mistreated and abused.  We make it a point to ensure that their lives never see pain or suffering again through steady veterinarian advised feeding and medical program attention.  Human interaction is a priority for re-homing potential.  In order to provide a sound future for the equines have and will care for we've developed a thorough foster and adoption screening process.  We ultimately focus on quality not quantity when it comes to adoptions.  

 We ask everyone to thoroughly investigate us as we would you.  Take a look at what we do and see for yourself who we are.  Supporting animal rescues is an important factor in the lively hood of the neglected and abused in your community. We implore people to support legitimate organizations only after you verify that they are in fact legitimate.
